static_traits.name: 林丹妮
static_traits.occupation: High school应届毕业生（即将入读大学）
static_traits.educational_background: High school graduate；即将就读肯塔基大学
static_traits.family_status: 有两个兄弟，家庭支持性Good
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationshipsGood，与兄弟和朋友关系融洽，但他们并not知晓其对挂科的强烈恐惧
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 语气中性，略显紧张；表达清晰、有逻辑；能Reflection自身认知与证据，配合度较高

basic_info.main_problem: 我有一个持续的想法，认为我可能会在大学的第一学期not及格，这让我非常Anxiety和压力。
basic_info.core_demands: 失败的恐惧一直占据我的想法并影响身心健康，因此在入学前希望通过咨询缓解Anxiety。
growth_experiences: High school阶段学业表现Good，整体功能稳定；进入大学前的过渡期中，自我要求较高、对新环境的适应充满not确定感，逐渐影响自信心。
从High school末期开始，最初对大学感到兴奋；随着大学开学日期临近，因担心without法应对新的学业要求与环境而产生对“第一学期会not及格”的强烈恐惧；该恐惧每日反复出现，在Being alone、入睡或进食时尤为明显；虽有支持性家人和朋友，但not yet向他们透露这份强烈的失败恐惧，Anxiety逐步影响睡眠与饮食。

core_beliefs: 我not够有能力，难以应对大学的学业要求
If I fail, I will disappoint my family

special_situations.event: As the start of university approaches、Being alone时反复思考not yet来的大学学习与环境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能适应新的环境与学业要求，就会挂科并让家人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries self-soothing and attending to positive outcomes; looks up university resources in advance and formulates study plans
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我大概会第一学期not及格

special_situations.event: 对比High school与大学难度，认为大学更难且与以往经验not同
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 大学比High school更难，我过去的成绩not能说明not yet来能成功；若without法完全掌控，就可能失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视正面证据（High school成绩Good），只关注潜在困难与威胁
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能应付not了大学课程

special_situations.event: When trying to sleep or eat, worries about failing courses repeatedly appear and intensify
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法在日常生活中缓解Anxiety，说明我not能应对大学压力，最终会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing specific fears with others, worrying alone repeatedly to try to maintain a sense of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may break down; I will very likely fail courses in the first semester

special_situations.event: When thinking about family's expectations and support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我第一学期失败，就会让家人失望，证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将恐惧保留在心里，not向家人或朋友深入透露以避免被评价

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain academic success in the new environment and continue gaining family's recognition and support
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被视为not够能力，从而让家人失望、失去被认可的感觉
defense_goal: 通过控制与自我克制保护自尊，避免暴露脆弱；not向家人朋友透露具体恐惧以减少被评判的风险

object_relations.object_representation: Family / others who are supportive but may be disappointed by failure

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about 'possibly failing a course' or being asked whether she shares such worries with family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为表达恐惧会让他人失望、显得自己not够能力（移情：将家人的期待Projection到咨询关系中）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、支持性；先正常化其担忧，再以开放式问题温和探索其not yet表达的情绪与需求；避免评价，允许停顿，邀请其具体化感受与想象的后果。

manifestations: 在Being alone、思考not yet来时担忧加剧
not yet向家人和朋友透露对失败的强烈恐惧，选择独自承受
担心without法融入大学环境与学业要求

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 会谈开场即表达“有点紧张、not确定会发生什么”
Repeatedly doubts and negatively evaluates one's abilities
not yet与支持系统分享具体恐惧，担心让家人失望而谨慎表达

positive_force: Having supportive family and friend relationships
High school阶段学业表现Good，具备勤奋与学习能力
Willing to proactively seek counseling and plan learning resources before enrollment (such as tutoring centers, study groups, making study plans)
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知模式Reinforcement失败Anxiety
对自身能力的持续怀疑导致Decreased confidence
在重要关系中隐忍恐惧、not yet及时获得外界支持，Loneliness负担增加

target_behavior.behavior: 对即将开始的大学学习的过度担忧与失败恐惧（Anxiety）
antecedent: As the start of university approaches
target_behavior.core_reason: 对新环境与学业要求的高度not确定感以及对让家人失望的担忧，形成对失败的灾难化Anticipation
target_behavior.function: 通过not断担忧和预演最坏结果来寻求控制感与提前准备，同时回避与他人讨论以避免被评价
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified、Sleep and diet affected、Decreased self-confidence，not yet充分利用社会支持
